class.name: VCSVDataTable
class.brief_description:
UE-DataTable-style table: binds CSV rows to a custom row type via reflection.
类似 UE DataTable 的数据表：通过反射把 CSV 行绑定到自定义行类型。
class.description:
[b]VCSVDataTable[/b] holds a string grid ([member headers] + [member rows]) plus a [member row_type] reference and lazily builds typed row objects. Row types are GDScript classes extending [Resource] (given as a [code]res://...gd[/code] path) or C++ [ClassDB]-registered classes. Each CSV column is mapped to a property of the same name (see [member case_insensitive_columns]) and cells are converted to the property's type.
Only the string grid and configuration are serialized (as a [code].tres[/code] via the editor import plugin); row objects are re-built from the *current* [member row_type] on first access, so editing the row script re-binds automatically.
Use [method get_row] / [method get_row_by_index] to fetch typed rows, [method get_row_dict] for string-level access, and [method set_cell_converter] to plug in custom cell conversion. [member key_column] selects the column used as the lookup key.
[b]VCSVDataTable[/b] 保存字符串网格（[member headers] + [member rows]）和 [member row_type] 引用，并在首次访问时懒构建类型化行对象。行类型可以是继承 [Resource] 的 GDScript 类（传 [code]res://...gd[/code] 路径）或 C++ [ClassDB] 注册类。每个 CSV 列映射到同名属性（见 [member case_insensitive_columns]），单元格按属性类型转换。
只有字符串网格和配置会被序列化（经编辑器导入插件存为 [code].tres[/code]）；行对象在首次访问时按*当前* [member row_type] 重建，因此修改行脚本会自动重绑定。
用 [method get_row] / [method get_row_by_index] 获取类型化行，[method get_row_dict] 做字符串级访问，[method set_cell_converter] 接入自定义单元格转换。[member key_column] 选择作为查找键的列。

method.name: ensure_loaded
method.description:
Builds (or rebuilds) the typed row cache if it is dirty. Returns [code]false[/code] on a structural failure (e.g. [member row_type] cannot be instantiated); per-cell conversion errors are recorded in [method get_last_errors] but do not fail the build.
若缓存已脏则构建（或重建）类型化行缓存。结构性失败（如 [member row_type] 无法实例化）返回 [code]false[/code]；单元格转换错误记入 [method get_last_errors]，不导致构建失败。

method.name: get_row
method.description:
Returns the typed row whose [member key_column] equals [param key], or [code]null[/code] if there is no such key (or no [member row_type]).
返回 [member key_column] 等于 [param key] 的类型化行；无此键（或无 [member row_type]）时返回 [code]null[/code]。

method.name: get_row_by_index
method.description:
Returns the typed row at [param index] (row order), or [code]null[/code] if out of range or no [member row_type].
返回第 [param index] 行（按行序）的类型化行；越界或无 [member row_type] 时返回 [code]null[/code]。

method.name: get_all_rows
method.description:
Returns all typed row objects in row order.
按行序返回全部类型化行对象。

method.name: get_keys
method.description:
Returns the values of [member key_column] for every data row, in row order.
按行序返回每行 [member key_column] 的值。

method.name: get_row_dict
method.description:
String-level lookup: returns header→cell as a [Dictionary] without building typed rows.
字符串级查询：不构建类型化行，直接返回 header→cell 的 [Dictionary]。

method.name: get_value
method.description:
Shorthand for [code]get_row(key).get(property)[/code].
[code]get_row(key).get(property)[/code] 的简写。

method.name: get_field_array
method.description:
Returns the native [Array] value of a typed row field (e.g. an [code]Array[String][/code] column) directly, so callers never need to [code]split()[/code] a CSV cell by hand. Returns an empty [code]Array[/code] when the row is missing, the field does not exist, or the value is not an [code]Array[/code].
直接返回类型化行字段的原生 [code]Array[/code] 值（如 [code]Array[String][/code] 列），调用方无需手工 [code]split()[/code] CSV 单元格。行缺失、字段不存在或值不是 [code]Array[/code] 时返回空 [code]Array[/code]。

method.name: has_key
method.description:
Returns [code]true[/code] if a row with [param key] exists.
是否存在 [param key] 对应的行。

method.name: row_count
method.description:
Number of data rows.
数据行数。

method.name: column_count
method.description:
Number of columns (header count).
列数（表头数）。

method.name: get_cell_converter
method.description:
Returns the custom cell converter, if any.
返回自定义单元格转换器（若有）。

method.name: set_cell_converter
method.description:
Sets a user converter invoked as [code]call(column_name, cell, property_dict, row_object)[/code]. Returning a non-[code]null[/code] value uses it as the property value; returning [code]null[/code] falls back to the built-in conversion.
设置用户转换器，以 [code]call(column_name, cell, property_dict, row_object)[/code] 调用。返回非 [code]null[/code] 值则用作属性值；返回 [code]null[/code] 则回退到内置转换。

method.name: set_linked_table
method.description:
Registers a linked table (a [VCSVDataTable] resource at [param path]) so that OBJECT-typed cells holding that table's row key resolve to the referenced row (foreign keys).
注册一张关联表（[param path] 处的 [VCSVDataTable] 资源），使 OBJECT 类型单元格中存的行键能解析为对应行（外键）。

method.name: refresh
method.description:
Marks the cache dirty so the next access rebuilds typed rows.
标记缓存为脏，下次访问时重建类型化行。

method.name: clear_cache
method.description:
Clears the typed-row cache (and marks it dirty).
清空类型化行缓存（并标记为脏）。

method.name: sort_rows
method.description:
Sorts the data grid in place by [param column] and rebuilds the typed cache / key index. Keyed lookups ([method get_row]) keep working; [method get_row_by_index] returns the sorted order.
按 [param column] 就地排序数据网格并重建类型化缓存/键索引。按键查询（[method get_row]）仍然可用；[method get_row_by_index] 返回排序后的顺序。

method.name: find_rows
method.description:
Returns the keys of rows whose [param column] cell matches [param value]. Requires [member key_column]; without one, row indices (as strings) are returned.
返回 [param column] 单元格匹配 [param value] 的行的键。需要 [member key_column]；没有时返回行下标（字符串形式）。

method.name: find_first_row
method.description:
Returns the key of the first matching row (or its index as a string), empty if none.
返回首个匹配行的键（或字符串形式的下标），无则空串。

method.name: get_column_values
method.description:
Returns every cell value of [param column] (raw strings, in row order).
返回 [param column] 每行的单元格值（原始字符串，按行序）。

method.name: get_distinct
method.description:
Unique cell values of [param column] in first-occurrence order.
[param column] 的唯一值，按首次出现顺序。

method.name: get_column
method.description:
All cell values of [param column] as raw strings, in row order.
[param column] 每行的单元格值（原始字符串，按行序）。

method.name: to_dict_array
method.description:
Returns an [Array] of [Dictionary] with typed values — read from bound row properties when [member row_type] is set, otherwise inferred cell types.
返回带类型化值的 [Dictionary] 的 [Array]——设置了 [member row_type] 时读取绑定行属性，否则用推断类型。

method.name: to_json_string
method.description:
JSON string of [method to_dict_array] (column order preserved).
[method to_dict_array] 的 JSON 字符串（保持列顺序）。

method.name: from_dict_array
method.description:
Builds a table from an [Array] of [Dictionary] rows, optionally bound to [param row_type]. The first header becomes the key column.
从 [Dictionary] 的 [Array] 构建表，可选绑定 [param row_type]。首个表头作为键列。

method.name: from_json_string
method.description:
Builds a table from a JSON array-of-dictionaries string, optionally bound to [param row_type].
从 JSON 字典数组字符串构建表，可选绑定 [param row_type]。

method.name: set_cell_value
method.description:
Sets one cell of the row identified by [param key] and rebuilds the typed cache.
设置 [param key] 标识行的某个单元格并重建类型化缓存。

method.name: set_row_dict
method.description:
Sets several cells of the row identified by [param key] from a Dictionary (header → value) and rebuilds the typed cache.
用 [Dictionary]（表头 → 值）一次设置 [param key] 标识行的多个单元格并重建类型化缓存。

method.name: append_dicts
method.description:
Appends rows from an [Array] of [Dictionary], aligned to this table's headers (unknown keys ignored, missing keys empty).
从 [Dictionary] 的 [Array] 追加行，按本表表头对齐（未知键忽略，缺失键为空）。

method.name: column_stats
method.description:
Aggregate statistics over a column (see [method VCSVTable.column_stats]).
对一列做聚合统计（见 [method VCSVTable.column_stats]）。

method.name: get_related
method.description:
Returns the typed row of linked table [param table_name] for [param key] (foreign-key lookup).
返回关联表 [param table_name] 中 [param key] 对应的类型化行（外键查找）。

method.name: get_related_dict
method.description:
String-level variant of [method get_related].
[method get_related] 的字符串级版本。

method.name: join_rows
method.description:
Merges each typed row with its resolved related row into one [Dictionary] (related columns prefixed [code]<table_name>.[/code]) for every row whose OBJECT property is bound to linked table [param table_name]'s row type. Enables cross-table flattened queries.
把每个类型化行与其解析到的关联行合并为一个 [Dictionary]（关联列加 [code]<表名>.[/code] 前缀），针对所有 OBJECT 属性绑定到关联表 [param table_name] 行类型的行。用于跨表扁平化查询。

method.name: remove_row
method.description:
Removes the row identified by [param key]. Returns [code]false[/code] if not found.
删除 [param key] 标识的行。未找到返回 [code]false[/code]。

method.name: filter
method.description:
Returns the typed rows for which [code]predicate.call(row)[/code] is truthy. Requires [member row_type].
返回 [code]predicate.call(row)[/code] 为真的类型化行。需要 [member row_type]。

method.name: to_table
method.description:
Returns a [VCSVTable] with the same headers and string rows.
返回带相同表头和字符串行的 [VCSVTable]。

method.name: get_table
method.description:
Alias for [method to_table] (CSVAccess-style naming).
[method to_table] 的别名（CSVAccess 风格命名）。

method.name: to_csv
method.description:
Serializes this table to a CSV file via [VCSVWriter]. Returns an [Error].
用 [VCSVWriter] 把本表序列化写入 CSV 文件。返回 [Error]。

method.name: export_rows_to_csv
method.description:
Writes only the rows whose key is in [param keys] (headers + the subset) to a CSV file. Returns an [Error].
只把键在 [param keys] 中的行（表头 + 子集）写入 CSV 文件。返回 [Error]。

method.name: export_row_to_csv
method.description:
Writes a single row (headers + one data row) identified by [param key] to a CSV file. Returns an [Error].
把 [param key] 标识的单行（表头 + 一行数据）写入 CSV 文件。返回 [Error]。

method.name: validate
method.description:
Data-integrity validation. Returns a [PackedStringArray] of issue messages (empty when clean). [param options] may contain [code]required_columns[/code] (Array of header names), [code]check_duplicate_keys[/code] (bool) and [code]check_required_columns[/code] (bool). Checks: missing required columns; type-conversion failures (row-level, from the last build); duplicate keys in [member key_column]; and unresolved foreign keys for OBJECT-typed columns against [member linked_tables]. The two [code]check_*[/code] options default from the project settings [code]vortariscsv/validation/check_duplicate_keys[/code] and [code]vortariscsv/validation/check_required_columns[/code] (both default [code]true[/code]); an explicit option key overrides the project setting per call.
数据完整性校验。返回问题消息的 [PackedStringArray]（干净时为空）。[param options] 可含 [code]required_columns[/code]（表头名数组）、[code]check_duplicate_keys[/code]（bool）与 [code]check_required_columns[/code]（bool）。检查：必填列缺失；类型转换失败（行级，取自上次构建）；[member key_column] 中的重复键；以及 OBJECT 类型列相对 [member linked_tables] 无法解析的外键。两个 [code]check_*[/code] 选项默认取自项目设置 [code]vortariscsv/validation/check_duplicate_keys[/code] 与 [code]vortariscsv/validation/check_required_columns[/code]（均默认 [code]true[/code]）；显式传入的选项键会逐次覆盖项目设置。

method.name: build_row
method.description:
Lazy mode only: builds (and caches) the typed row at original data-row index [param index]. Returns [code]null[/code] when [member lazy_build] is off, the row is not a data row, or the row type cannot be instantiated.
仅懒加载模式：构建（并缓存）位于原始数据行下标 [param index] 的类型化行。[member lazy_build] 关闭、该行不是数据行或行类型无法实例化时返回 [code]null[/code]。

method.name: poll_hot_reload
method.description:
Compares [member source_path]'s mtime against the last loaded one; when it changed, re-parses the file and marks the cache dirty. Returns [code]true[/code] when a reload happened. A no-op unless [member hot_reload] and [member source_path] are set.
比较 [member source_path] 的修改时间与上次加载值；变化时重新解析文件并标记缓存为脏。发生重载时返回 [code]true[/code]。[member hot_reload] 与 [member source_path] 未设置时为无操作。

method.name: get_hot_tables
method.description:
Returns the registered hot-reload tables (valid instances with [member hot_reload] enabled). Dead entries are pruned automatically.
返回已注册的热重载表（启用 [member hot_reload] 的有效实例）。失效条目会自动清理。

method.name: get_last_errors
method.description:
Errors from the last build (each prefixed with row/col where known).
上次构建产生的错误（已知时带行/列前缀）。

method.name: get_last_warnings
method.description:
Warnings from the last build (e.g. properties without a matching column).
上次构建产生的警告（如无对应列的属性）。

method.name: from_file
method.description:
One-shot runtime load: parses [param path] with [param options] and returns a ready [VCSVDataTable] bound to [param row_type]. The first header column becomes the key column unless [member key_column] is set later. The returned table defaults to the project settings [code]vortariscsv/general/lazy_build_default[/code] and [code]vortariscsv/general/hot_reload_default[/code] (both default [code]false[/code]); set [member lazy_build] / [member hot_reload] afterwards to override.
一次性运行时加载：用 [param options] 解析 [param path]，返回绑定 [param row_type] 的 [VCSVDataTable]。首个表头列作为键列，除非之后设置 [member key_column]。返回的表默认采用项目设置 [code]vortariscsv/general/lazy_build_default[/code] 与 [code]vortariscsv/general/hot_reload_default[/code]（均默认 [code]false[/code]）；之后可再设置 [member lazy_build] / [member hot_reload] 覆盖。

method.name: load_typed
method.description:
Typed one-shot convenience: parses [param path] with default options and returns a ready [VCSVDataTable] bound to [param row_type] once. Cache the returned table so repeated [method get_row] calls hit the built-in typed-row cache instead of rebuilding a table per lookup. Equivalent to [method from_file] with [code]null[/code] options.
类型化一次性便捷方法：用默认选项解析 [param path]，一次性绑定 [param row_type] 并返回就绪的 [VCSVDataTable]。缓存返回的表，使重复的 [method get_row] 调用命中内置类型化行缓存，而不必每次查找都重建表。等价于 options 为 [code]null[/code] 的 [method from_file]。

members.member:
Column names (first CSV row when [VCSVParseOptions.has_header]).
列名（[VCSVParseOptions.has_header] 时的首行）。

Data rows as [PackedStringArray] entries.
数据行（元素为 [PackedStringArray]）。

Column used as the lookup key for [method get_row]. Empty = no keying.
作为 [method get_row] 查找键的列。空 = 无键。

Row type: a [code]res://...gd[/code] script path or a C++ [ClassDB] class name. Must extend [Resource].
行类型：一个 [code]res://...gd[/code] 脚本路径或 C++ [ClassDB] 类名。必须继承 [Resource]。

Header→canonical type-name overrides (e.g. [code]{"hp": "int"}[/code]). Empty = use each property's declared type.
表头→规范类型名覆盖（如 [code]{"hp": "int"}[/code]）。空 = 使用属性声明的类型。

Match CSV column names to properties ignoring case.
列名与属性名匹配时忽略大小写。

Sub-delimiter inside a cell for array-typed properties (e.g. [code]"1;2;3"[/code]).
数组类型属性单元格内的子分隔符（如 [code]"1;2;3"[/code]）。

Cells equal to this token keep the property default (treated as no value).
等于此标记的单元格保留属性默认值（视为无值）。

Table name→resource path, used for foreign-key resolution.
表名→资源路径，用于外键解析。

User-defined cell converter (see [method set_cell_converter]).
用户自定义单元格转换器（见 [method set_cell_converter]）。

Source CSV path used by [method poll_hot_reload]. Not persisted in the [code].tres[/code].
供 [method poll_hot_reload] 使用的源 CSV 路径。不会持久化到 [code].tres[/code]。

When true, registers this table for hot reload and enables [method poll_hot_reload] (called automatically by the editor plugin on filesystem changes). Tables created via [method from_file] or the editor import default to the project setting [code]vortariscsv/general/hot_reload_default[/code].
为 true 时注册本表以启用热重载，并开启 [method poll_hot_reload]（编辑器插件会在文件系统变化时自动调用）。经 [method from_file] 或编辑器导入创建的表默认采用项目设置 [code]vortariscsv/general/hot_reload_default[/code]。

Minimum seconds between [method poll_hot_reload] checks (0 = no throttle).
[method poll_hot_reload] 两次检查之间的最小秒数（0 = 不限流）。

When true, [method ensure_loaded] builds only the structure (layout + key index); typed rows are constructed on demand by [method build_row] / [method get_row] / [method get_row_by_index]. When false (default), every row is built up front (eager). Tables created via [method from_file] or the editor import default to the project setting [code]vortariscsv/general/lazy_build_default[/code].
为 true 时 [method ensure_loaded] 只构建结构（布局 + 键索引）；类型化行由 [method build_row] / [method get_row] / [method get_row_by_index] 按需构建。为 false（默认）时一次性构建全部行（即时）。经 [method from_file] 或编辑器导入创建的表默认采用项目设置 [code]vortariscsv/general/lazy_build_default[/code]。

signal.name: build_failed
signal.description:
Emitted when the typed-row build fails (structural or per-cell).
类型化行构建失败时发出（结构性或逐单元格）。
